title: ChIP-seq Gene Set Compare
subtitle: Compare a curated human gene set with real ChIP-seq heatmaps. Search genes, paste identifiers, and run a batched matrix query.

input.title: Gene Set Input
input.searchDescription: Load human gene options on demand and keep up to 10 genes in compare order.
input.searchPlaceholder: Search gene symbol, Ensembl ID, or gene ID
input.pasteDescription: Supports gene_id, gene_name, and Ensembl ID. Split with spaces, commas, semicolons, or new lines.
input.emptyIdentifiers: Paste at least one gene_id, gene_name, or Ensembl ID.
input.tooManyIdentifiers: At most {{max}} identifiers can be resolved at once.
input.maxGenesReached: Only the first {{max}} genes are kept in v1.

results.pendingChanges: Configuration changed. Run compare again to refresh the heatmap.
results.empty: Choose a human gene set and run compare to render the batched heatmap.
results.failedGenesTitle: Some genes could not be rendered
results.noSuccessfulGenes: No gene returned a valid heatmap matrix for the current selection.
